items.title: Panel discussion on Jineolojî and self-defense in Marseille
items.description: A panel discussion and commemoration event focusing on Jineolojî and the formation of women’s armed forces was held in Marseille, France, organized by the Association of Martyrs’ Families (KOMAW), the Marseille Arîn Mîrkan Women’s Council, and members of Jineolojî Provence. The event, held at the Marseille Kurdish Democratic Community Center, was attended by numerous Kurdish women from the region, as well as representatives of French internationalist women’s movements. items.title: We are not waiting for revolutionary conditions
items.description: The task is to organize where we are and build relationships strong enough to move together. People often say the conditions are not there and we are not ready. We never will be unless we build those conditions, and building them means building the power of the people in a very real sense. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops. items.title: Οι εξεγερμένοι στη Γαλλία δεν εγκαταλείπουν τη γιορτή του δρόμου και τον αγώνα ενάντια στο σύστημα!
items.description: Την εξέγερση που σαρώνει αυτή τη στιγμή τη Γαλλία, αυτή τη σπίθα που απλώνεται σε Ισπανία, Πορτογαλία, Βέλγιο, Ιταλία, Αλβανία επιχειρήθηκε να φωτιστεί στην κατάμεστη αίθουσα του infolibre, το Σάββατο το βράδυ μέσα από μαρτυρίες ανθρώπων που έζησαν τις πρόσφατες διαδηλώσεις στο Παρίσι στις 17/10, από συμμετέχοντες στη διαδήλωση του Σαββάτου 24/10 και μαρτυρίες φοιτητ(ρι)ών. Μετέφεραν το κλίμα στη Γαλλία όπου οι εξεγερμένοι είναι αποφασισμένοι να μην εγκαταλείψουν το δρόμο και το σπάσιμο με το σύστημα, να παραμείνουν σε αυτή τη γιορτή της ανθρωπιάς και της αλληεγγύης, στο διαρκή αγώνα με κύριο σύνθημα: Ο κόσμος ή τίποτα. items.title: Joyeux anniversaire à l'AIF
items.description: Depuis 2021, au Myanmar, l'armée birmane a de nouveau repris le pouvoir par un coup d'État. Ancienne colonie britannique, le pays a ensuite essuyé plusieurs décennies de contrôle par l'armée birmane (Tatmadaw) avant d'avoir un début de transition démocratique en 2015. Cette séquence démocratique, loin d'être parfaite, comme tous les régimes politiques, a vite été balayée par la reprise du pouvoir par l'armée officielle du Myanmar. Depuis 5 ans donc, des groupes armés rebelles s'organisent et font face à cette hégémonie. Ils sont nombreux et tentent de faire front commun contre la Tatmadaw et ses alliées (Chine et Russie). items.title: YBŞ and YJŞ: Success of the agreement depends on protecting Yazidi rights
items.description: The Shengal Resistance Units (YBŞ) and the Shengal Women’s Units (YJŞ) have confirmed their agreement with the Iraqi government to integrate a total of 4,165 fighters into the state security forces. At a ceremony in the Shengal Mountains on Monday, the two forces stated that the success of the agreement would depend on whether the rights of the Yazidi population were protected, the consequences of the genocide were addressed, and the agreed commitments were fulfilled. items.title: All power to the people is something we build
items.description: General Strike U.S. describes a phase where a movement has built something beyond capitalism, is ready to withdraw, is ready to sustain that withdrawal and has material power behind it. We don't disappear after disruption, the speaker says. We govern what we build, a dual and contending power becoming real power. All power to the people is something actually being built and committed to. items.title: Power is the capacity to act
items.description: General Strike U.S. and The Panther Party defines power as something you can hold: the ability to define a phenomenon and make it act in the desired manner. Political power backed by the ability to enact a political consequence is real, and any proclamation without that backing is words on paper. The aim is the capacity of the people to affect their material conditions directly, to protect ourselves and make the things we need. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops. items.title: Solidarity has to move beyond statements
items.description: General Strike U.S. names the systems that tie our struggles together: capitalism, imperialism, colonialism, white supremacy and state repression. Because those systems are connected, solidarity has to move beyond statements, symbolism and idealism. It has to be rooted in practice and in material struggle together. From the workshop "Many Struggles, One Fight: Building Autonomous Intercommunal Power, Direct Action Strategies and Revolutionary General Strike Networks" at the 2026 International Workshops.
